v: Emotional movie without emotions 🙏😪 Srinu and I went in out of curiosity and came out wondering why neither of us had the sense to say NO 😂
e: THAMMUDU has the bones of a commercial emotional drama, but the painfully linear narration drains the masala, tension and emotion out of it. The cinematography is excellent and Laya’s comeback is welcome, but the writing left Srinu and me wondering why we ignored all warning signs.
body:
Before going into my experience of the movie….let me take the opportunity to introduce you to Srinu, my Partner in Crime for Watching Movies and together we witnessed many Epics and Disasters for the past 15 odd years 🙏

While we were stepping into the AMB to watch this movie, Srinu asked me a question : Poorna, did you realise that this is the first time we are watching Nithin’s movie on a First Day!!! Can you care to explain why are we doing this?

and my answer was : I don’t know Srinu, for me even the trailer of the movie looked pretty ordinary but have seen few so called Honest Interviews and Interactions between Dil Raju and Nithin which raised curiosity in me and also the fact that this movie got A certificate which they claim justify the content of the movie raised curiosity in me to watch this movie on First day itself!!!!

And after watching this movie and while stepping out of AMB, I asked Srinu a question : Srinu, naakante siggu ledhu prathi movie ki edo oka reason chepi tempt avutha…..neekana budhi undakarla?? vadhu Poorna ani chepachu ga!!!!

and as usual Srinu never answers or reacts….he simply tried to cover up his pain with a smile on his face 🙏

Srinu and Me seriously tried to search for a Psychiatrist near by AMB to get checked if we both lost sensitivity in our hearts along the sense of reacting emotionally because we were watching a movie which had so many emotional scenes but still we both were not feeling any bit of it? 

But later realised that it the unique ability of the Director Sriram Venu to Direct an Emotional Movie without Emotions in it 😪 

We have seen so many occasions where the so called Hollywood & OTT Movie Watchers (Self proclaimed intellectuals) complaining that Tollywood is killing interesting stories by commercialising the movie by adding unwanted Comedy, Elevations and Masala!!! 

Especially they have criticised Sreeram Venu for making an out and out commercial movie MCA with Nani….and this movie and screenplay would be a slipper-shot answer to them, as they would also be begging the director to add some masala into this otherwise very Linear and non engaging storytelling. Fun Fact : He used the almost same MCA plot to make this movie without adding any commercial formula 😂 thus giving a proper tribute to MCA!!! and the irony is Nani was supposed to play Nithin’s character but somehow he escaped 😳

Story wise the movie had full scope to be a proper commercial mass masala movie….but unfortunately for som unknown reason the Director choose to narrate this in Non Commercial Format 🙄 and please don’t be of the opinion that he could be an Off Beat Director. He is the one who directed Nani’s MCA 😂 . The very thought of Directing a Potentially Commercial Story in a Very much Non Commercial Narration should fetch Oscar for the whole Team 🫡. The very fact that the director couldn’t clearly establish if Varsha is a Lover or Good Friend of Nithin shows how confused he was!! The way he assumed that showing Heroine as Love interest of Hero is Routine commercial and hence tried to convey her as his Friend to give an Off Beat movie vibes but ended up calling her as his COMPANION (which I am yet to decode) shows how confused he was to project a simple relation 🤔

I feel pity for Nithin, as majority of his recent movies though having a potential of being Hit at-least on paper couldn’t give him proper success due to mishandling of the subject by the Directors. While his Robinhood flopped with over usage of commercial elements Thammudu completely lacks them 🫩. Hope he soon finds a way to balance Content with commercial elements.

Also Saurabh Sachdeva (Animal fame) is being over used by Tollywood directors…his acting and expressions which looked unique and gelled well in Animal are looking too loud and over the top in other films especially when they give him

unique behaviour without properly utilising it later 

I personally feel that Laya was overrated during her times and being a Telugu Heroine only helped her and she used to choose her characters wisely to give that impression of her being an excellent artist, and thats why No one of us literally missed her when she took break from acting!!! But for a change….her comeback into movies is the only matter of interest in this whole movie 🙏

 The Cinematography is of Top Notch and blended well with the excellent visuals of the Forest locations which brings down my biggest question ever? Why did Manchu anna choose New Zealand  Resort type Forest’s over these beautiful rustic Forest shown in this movie to shoot Kannapa 🤔🤔

Also while I was wondering why this Movie got A certificate?? My Friend, Living Legend Srinu enlightened me saying that its because the censor board wanted to save as many lives as possible from getting depressed of not getting emotional after watching an emotional movie 🙏

v: Three hours of torture for a story that needed maybe 30–45 mins 😭😂 Prabhas finally arrives like a saviour, not just for Kannappa... for us too 🙏
e: KANNAPA’s core devotional material could have worked as a short, focused film, but the bloated runtime, weak VFX, strange diction, over-the-top presentation and unintentionally funny first half made it a torturous experience for me. Prabhas is the rare relief.
body:
its a almost a 20 mins Prabhas film in which Manchu Vishnu did a Lengthy Cameo for 3 hrs 3 mins out of which he gave his Career best performance for 3 mintues (still mediocre or average performance compared to many other actors in Tollywood) 

The Film starts with almost 5 minutes Song giving us insights about SRIKALAHASTI temple and in 10 min pre and post interval scenes we will be shown the past relationship between Lord Shiva and Kannapa and in the last 3 minutes we would be shown what we have been waiting for the last 3 hrs, i.e why Kannapa is considered one of the greatest Shiva Bhakt.

This could have been a nice 30 – 45 mins Film with proper impact and screenplay but unfortunately the Director has chosen this to be made at a length of 3 hrs 3 mins of never ending saga 🙏 But in the defence of the Director Mukesh Kumar Singh, he never had an experience of directing a Movie and all his experience is from TV serials and he made perfect justice to his experience by making this movie a never ending saga with very mediocre or Medium Budgeted TV serial Graphics 

When you have 90% of the Star cast and Cameos either doing the movie for free or at peanut’s price and still if the Producer is claiming to spend 200 to 300 crores on this movie then we as audience expect some grand visuals and good cgi but instead we get to see blurred images and most of the times you can almost feel the green screen…I guess team didn’t put any budget and intelligently blurred images to fool audience as if they had Censor Issues 😂 

For the first time I was watching a Telugu movie trying to read the subtitles to understand dialogues….because 75% of the time you feel that the Voice has been dubbed by International English Medium Kids trying to speak proper Telugu with English accent and in some cases you will even find Hindi, Tamil and Malayalam accents as well 🙏 Its only Mohan babu who as usual had proper command over the language and played his part well. Though Sharthkumar tried his best to deliver in proper Telugu but you can literally feel that he is trying very hard!!! A part from Sharthkumar no other actor including Vishnu tried to work on their Telugu diction. Also the film is totally shot in New Zealand  and hence the forest background didn’t give me the local vibes instead they should have shot it some forests near Kerala or North Eastern India 🤔. Because of the English Telugu Accent dialogues, Location and more importantly over the top makeup of each artist with Fake Tattoos…we will not get a feeling of watching a proper Telugu movie though the story is completely native ☹️

On top of it the First Half is Total Mess filled with with Cringe scenes and dialogues like :

  1. Nemali ni Pelli chesukoni Namili vadilestha!!
  2. Till then Hero does all kind of Romance in front of his Mothers Samadi and suddenly says there is no Temple greater than his Mothers Samadhi for him 🙏
  3. The movie had lot many Lady Warriors but looks like their Fights have been choreographed by Dancers instead of Fight Masters!!! All their Moves look like as if their doing sexy dances with sword in their hands ☹️
  4. All the Heroine scenes could be best suited for Liril soap ad campaigns 😂
  5. I am not sure why we still need to follow Raghavendra Rao’s school of showing hot romance in devotional movies. The costumes of Heroine even while praying to God, gives erotic vibes more than devotional feel

For the first time ever have seen audience in PVR multiplex laughing out loud and booing scenes and banging heads for a movie which was supposed to be serious.

After you go through his awful experience….sometime in Second Half Prabhas comes as a saviour not only in the Film or For the Film but also to give solace to audience for going through all the torture 🙏

Off-late I used to have complaint against Prabhas for his lazy acting and dialogue delivery style…..but in movie I felt that his same style as whistle worthy and subtle, it could be because of the role or dialogues he got or it could be completely because of the torture my mind went through after all those over the top acting by remaining artists 😂

PS : My 12 year old daughter forced me to add this line “in the name of Devotion dont take your kids to this movie and traumatise them”

v: Loved the idea, realism and performances 🙏 Dhanush is terrific, Nag fits like a glove... but I can totally understand if the length tests your patience.
e: Sekhar Kammula strips a familiar rich-vs-poor setup of hero worship and commercial formula, then lets Dhanush, Nagarjuna and the writing carry it. I enjoyed the realism, performances and philosophical dialogue, though the pacing may make it a harder recommendation for everyone.
body:
there are few kind of movies which while watching you get suck into the brilliant concept, near to realistic execution, career best performances by the lead and supporting cast and yet you come out of the theatre with a feel of something is missing…..and Kuberaa is one such movie where though I enjoyed the off beat concept and narration but I might hesitate to suggest others to watch this movie as I overheard conversations of few audiences feeling that the movie is a test to their patience 

Story wise, we have seen many movies with the storyline of Rich vs Poor which has scope for pure commercial formula!!! But its Sekhar Kammula’s vision to set up an Ultra Rich vs a Begger in a near Realistic approach without any commercial elements should be appreciated 🙏 

Especially the way he designed few scenes, only a director who gives ZERO FUCKS to Hero Worship and Commercial Story Telling can only pull such things off 🙏

Acting wise Dhanush is sure shot to get all the awards for his acting…His body language, Smile, Dialogue Delivery everything makes us believe that he has been a begger since his childhood….The only thing that put me off was I felt Dhanush was bit hefty in couple of scenes for a Begger 😂😉

In his Vast Career I personally feel that No Role perfectly suited Nagarjuna’s body language and Voice Modulation as much as this role suited him 🙏 Its as if he was born to portray this role to perfection 🫡

Initially I was surprised on why Sekhar ditched Sai Pallavi for Rashmika, but after watching movie I understood that out of all Sekhar’s movies this is the one which has weak arch for an actress but still its yards ahead when compared to Heroine roles in other movies…and Rashmika though with her own limitations and regular trying to be cute expressions gave way more matured performance 

The only commercial aspect of this movie is DSP’s Background Music….and he did elevate intense scenes with his terrific BGM which gives goosebumps.

Special Shout Out to the Thought provoking dialogues….especially the one where Rashmika indirectly makes all of realise that we are Beggers in one way or the other is pure Philosophical 🙏

Length of the movie could be a reason of complaint for some….but thats the case with each and every Sekhar’s movie. I have seen fee reviews of complaining about abrupt climax but I felt with no commercial elements included where the Hero is not educated to take on the Corporate system Intelligently nor has brute power to beat the shit out of them…then its the only possible way to reach the climax of the movie, else it would have been a never ending saga 🙄

v: Good rustic action drama with a solid friendship/betrayal setup. Not a must-watch for me, but definitely a nice comeback for Manoj, Rohith & Bellamkonda 😊
e: BHAIRAVAM has a strong friendship-and-betrayal core, excellent BGM and cinematography, and committed performances from Nara Rohith, Manchu Manoj and Bellamkonda Sreenivas. Some Kantara-like echoes and an unresolved opening conflict hold it back, but it remains a very good effort for the team and budget.
body:
a Semi Rustic Rural Action which could have been an impactful and must watch movie but ends up being an overall Good Movie. Nevertheless a much needed comeback for Manchu Manoj, Nara Rohit and Bellamkonda Srinivas….

STORY : Story is the heart and soul of this movie. The filmmakers waste no time in throwing you straight into the story from the very beginning. The first five minutes might feel suffocating , as much of the stiry is conveyed through narration during the opening titles, but it prepares you for what’s to come. Though the first half reminds us of KANTARA in bits and pieces but the multi dimensional setup of friendship and betrayal is what the major plot of the movie!!! I was so impressed with the story and had high things to mention about Vijay Kanakamedala that it disappointed me a lot when I got to k ow that its a REMAKE 🤐

STORY & DIRECTION by Vijay Kanakamedala, there is nothing much to talk about the story as it’s a remake….Direction was good but should have taken basic care to avoid similarities that could have reminded us of KANTARA not sure why such basic effort was not put into avoid a plot line. Also the other thing which didn’t satisfy me was that there was no closure to the opening conflict established during the titles!!!! A simple scene to provide a closure to the conflict should have  done wonders rather than leaving it to the audience assumption that issue might been solved 🤷

After his back 2 back ventures with Allari Naresh for Nandhi and Ugram, Vijay directing the comeback for Nara Rohith, Manchu Manoj & Bellamkonda Srinivas…..I am sure he will the Comeback Director for many other stars who are eager to comeback with a bang 😊🥰

BGM by Sricharan Pakala was Too Good and also the songs are catchy. Cinematography was top notch and the visuals create an impact for sure!!!!

Acting wise its a comeback for Nara Rohith, Nara Rohith has this habit of selecting Niche Subjects where the content does all the talking and he can manage with with typical dialogue delivery style and expressions without putting much efforts 😉 and he did exactly the same in this movie just shouldering his character as Vardha with his subtle expressions and dialogues 

Manchu Manoj who is known for his offbeat subjects, characters & acting styles is back doing the same….he has done exceptionally well with the character having grey shades and who is struck in a conflict 🙏 Its a true comeback for him and if he can control

that extra bit of over expressions and dialogue delivery, I am sure he can do wonders in his second innings

Kudos to Bellamkonda Srinivas for trying to pull of a character which is almost equivalent to a character artist in the First half and carries the second half on his shoulders 🙏 and he plays a complicated role which challenge’s his acting capabilities and he put in a lot of hard work 👍 but unfortunately though he gave his best there could be inevitable comparisons with what Rishab Shetty has pulled off in Kantara 😪 and I put the complete blame for this on the Director

Actress Aditi Shankar standout with her performance as Village girl and her dance moves….but her dubbing as village girl should have been take care of as it doesn’t sync in aptly. Thats the only Technical issue i have noticed in this movie

Overall, This is Very Good Movie considering the Team and Budget…..

PS : I don’t understand how the Censor board works? How and Why they gave this movie A is a billion dollar question 🫡
